name: hud_ui_mgr_sensor_set_shield_message_ratio
description: HudUiMgrSensor::SetShieldMessageRatio clamps the shield ratio, updates shield meter color and fill geometry, writes the percent text, and invalidates the affected HUD elements.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native shield-message ratio tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x411f10 validates clamping ratio to 0..1, using red/yellow meter color with green enabled at ratios at or above 0.25, computing ceil(fillPixelsMax * ratio), moving meter points 0 and 3 upward from point 1, invalidating the meter, writing ceil(ratio * 100) to the percent panel with format "%d", and invalidating the panel.
The native shield-message smoke verifies low-ratio color and fill, high clamp to 100 percent and full fill, low clamp to zero percent and empty fill, and invalidation on the meter/panel path.
